messages:
dina: Quick question — when a tenant on Dedicated spills over to Hosted, how should we show that in the Console and telemetry? specifically: attribution (who pays), model-variant labels (did we fallback to quantized/opt), and a short UX to let customers opt-out of spillover for a few minutes? :thinking:

ben: We currently tag requests with `routing.path` but it doesn't capture explicit 'spillover': true or which variant used. We should add two things: `spillover=true|false` and `spillover.variant=hosted-v1/hosted-quant` so evals/alerts can filter.

alice: Agreed. Also need billing attribution rule: tenant should be charged per their contract even when served on Hosted (unless they agreed to pay Hosted rates). So telemetry needs `billing.node=hosted` + `charge_account=tenant_id` and the billing pipeline can apply pricing rules.

carlos: UX note: don't hide this. Console should show a temporary banner on the tenant's Dedicated config: "Running on Hosted due to capacity; expected back in ~5m" with a link to details. Add a small toggle "reject spillover for X minutes" for emergency protection (force reject rather than route).

dina: That toggle raises legal/data concerns for Private/VPC customers. It must be disabled for tenants with data_plane=private. We also need automatic consent recording. If a customer opts into spillover (on signup), record TOS flag and expose in audit logs.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: New feature branch pushed: `spillover-metadata` — adds `spillover.*` tags to request logs. CI: green.

ben: Proposal for API-level trace we can return to customers in response header/body when spillover occurs: `{ "routing": { "mode": "hosted-spillover", "variant": "hosted-quant-v2", "fallback_reason": "dedicated-eviction" } }` That helps customers map quality regressions in their tests.

alice: +1. Also add `x-redwood-routing: hosted-spillover;variant=hosted-quant-v2` in response header for quick debugging.

carlos: Regarding cost: telemetry pipeline should emit two metrics per request: `tokens_billed` (tenant) and `tokens_incurred` (infrastructure). That way finance can reconcile Hosted infra cost vs tenant billing.

dina: How do we surface model variant mismatches in rollouts? e.g., tenant pins model `redwood-xl` but hosted fallback is `redwood-xl-quant`. We should show a diff in Console under Deployments > Serving Differences: what changed (quantization, seq length, perf delta).

alice: UI sketch: small expandable card with fields: "Requested model", "Served model", "Estimated perf" (latency tokens/s), "Quality delta" (if we have eval set). Link to open an incident or to override.

carlos: Implementation question: where to compute `spillover.variant`? runtime decides (it picks nearest compatible variant), so runtime must emit it as part of request metadata. The control plane should persist a short-lived spillover event for the tenant for 10 minutes so console can show timeline.

ben: Also add an SLI: `spillover_rate` per tenant and `spillover_retries` to catch oscillations. If >5% for 1h then send paging to oncall.

dina: Edge case: what if we route to hosted but fail an enterprise privacy check at runtime? Need to abort and return 403 with a clear code. Document that in the API errors guide.

ops-bot: alert: canary deploy scheduled for `spillover-metadata` at 04:00 UTC. Will roll to 5% first.

alice: UX followups for Console team: 1) Banner + opt-out toggle, 2) Serving differences card, 3) Audit visible in activity log with TOS flag. I'll file a tiny design ticket.

carlos: Dev tasks: runtime emit `spillover.*`, control plane store ephemeral event, telemetry enrich pipeline, billing mapping. I'll split into PRs.

dina: OK. Last ask: add a short text snippet we can return in responses when spillover occurs so customers' logs show it easily. Minimal and stable: "notice": "served_via_hosted_spillover".

alice: SG. I'll add copy and a tooltip explaining "Hosted spillover may serve a compatible model variant during capacity events. Contact support for billing changes."

ben: I'll update the API spec and add header + body example in the docs. Also add a sample log query for Support: `json.payload.spillover.variant:hosted-quant*`

dina: Thanks all. If someone from Console or Billing wants to pair with me tomorrow at 10:30 PT, ping here. :thumbsup:
